rationale: Persist the already-proven Star PED authoritative publication and certified evidence outputs as frozen governed data artifacts using the existing generic certification, publication materialization, artifact persistence, and published-source lookup machinery. No governed implementation changes are introduced.
supersession_impact: No capability or historical certification artifact is superseded. This closes the repository-persistence prerequisite that PR #241 exercised only in a temporary repository.
authority_impact: No authority is broadened. The frozen publication remains bounded to the already-certified standard PED waiting-period duration and continuity component, with customer-specific eligibility, claim payment, and optional 12-month buy-back selection remaining outside ordinary assertion authority.
